facts.text: Bryn Mawr College offers Praxis, a community-engaged learning program that integrates academic coursework with fieldwork alongside community partners.

sources.title: Academic Opportunities: Praxis - Bryn Mawr College
sources.quote: Praxis is a curricular, experiential, and community-engaged learning (CEL) program. It integrates theory and practice through collaboration with community partners as part of academic courses.
